plugins.description: Complete 21-phase local business SEO audit system for Claude Code. Includes LOCAL-IMPACT (60-item) and SERP-TRUST (50-item) proprietary scoring frameworks. 27 auto-activating skills, 40 slash commands, 6 sub-agents for parallel execution. Covers technical SEO, on-page, content strategy, keyword gaps, competitor analysis, Google Business Profile, AI visibility (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), entity optimization, backlink analysis. Generates professionally designed PDF reports with SVG gauge charts. Produces prioritized 30/90/180/365-day action plans.
